parameters.query: SELECT app.get_webhook_event((p->>'id')::uuid) AS ev FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p) x WHERE p->>'id' ~* '^[0-9a-f-]{36}$'
SELECT app.upsert_woo_products(coalesce(p->'items', '[]')) AS n FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p) x
SELECT app.upsert_woo_order_ref(p) AS r, app.setting('followups') AS followups FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p) x
SELECT app.enqueue_system_message((p->>'conversation_id')::uuid, 'notification', 'utility', p->>'body', '{}'::jsonb, p->>'dedupe') AS r FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p) x
SELECT app.upsert_woo_products(coalesce(p->'items', '[]')) AS n FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p) x
